applicable_when: The kernel is a GEMM (M=7840, N=32, K=192) with ALLOW_TF32=False, forcing FP32 FFMA instead of Tensor Cores. Compute SOL is only 10.6% — the FP32 FFMA path is ~8x slower than TF32 Tensor Cores. The scheduler issues an instruction only every 8 cycles (12.47% eligible rate) with <1 active warp/scheduler, indicating severe compute starvation. Enabling TF32 (allow_tf32=True) routes tl.dot through Tensor Core MMA instructions, dramatically increasing compute throughput. K=192 is small (well below the K>512 danger threshold for accumulated TF32 error), so precision loss from 23->10 mantissa bits is within acceptable tolerance. Additionally, the current BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=32, BLOCK_K=32 tile configuration with only 123 blocks leaves 9 SMs idle; autotune will explore configurations that better cover all 132 SMs and improve occupancy.
